name: nib-dev-harness
description: NOT SHIPPED. Development-only test harness for Nib's front end, in two tiers: jsdom (test/jsdom) and a real browser against the real binary (test/ui). Nib itself is a single Go binary with the web assets embedded (see embed.go); nothing here is part of a release, and node_modules/ is git-ignored. Each tier states its own ceiling where it lives.
